XILNEX REPORT STUDIO · ICON01 / 07
Design concept

Five parts, one idea

1
2
3
4
5
  • 1
    Rounded tileThe product container. Soft corners match the icon shapes people see on modern devices.
  • 2
    X formTaken from the Xilnex mark. It ties every product icon back to the parent brand.
  • 3
    Glass panelA frosted layer that lifts the product letter forward, in the Fluent material style.
  • 4
    Letter RNames the product. Bold and geometric so it stays readable at small sizes.
  • 5
    Segmented bandFour steps from light to dark that read as a bar of data, the core of reporting.

XILNEX REPORT STUDIO · ICON04 / 07
Usage

Clear space, minimum size, backgrounds

x x x x
Clear space

Keep at least x = ⅛ of the icon's width empty on every side. At 1024 px that is 128 px; at 64 px it is 8 px.

Minimum size
16 pxBrowser favicon only
24 pxSmallest size in app menus and lists
48 px+Launchers, marketing, presentations
Backgrounds
WhiteLight lavenderDark #1A1030
XILNEX REPORT STUDIO · ICON05 / 07
Misuse

Always use the supplied file as it is

✕
Don't stretch or squash
Scale proportionally only.
✕
Don't rotate
The icon always sits upright.
✕
Don't recolour
Violet is the Report Studio colour.
✕
Don't add effects
No outlines, glows or extra shadows.
✕
Don't crop
Show the whole tile and panel.
✕
Don't place on mid-violet
The tile edge disappears.
